ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems delivered exceptional Q2 FY27 consolidated financial performance, with revenue soaring 72% and PAT climbing 54% YoY, underpinned by strategic expansions including an IAF smart bomb prototype order, clearance for the Premier Explosives acquisition, and forming a new entity for full weapon system development. These initiatives firmly position the company as a rapidly growing indigenous defense OEM; however, as a promotional tear sheet, it lacks comprehensive financial details and independent risk analysis.
